data.name: sqlInsertCommand.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO [tblAdditionalInterests] ([Interest], [Address1], [Address2], [City], [County], [StateID], [Region], [ISOCountryCode], [ZipCode], [ZipPlus], [mobile], [email]) VALUES (@Interest, @Address1, @Address2, @City, @County, @StateID, @Region, @ISOCountryCode, @ZipCode, @ZipPlus, @mobile, @email); SELECT InterestID, Interest, Address1, Address2, City, County, StateID, Region, ISOCountryCode, ZipCode, ZipPlus, mobile, email FROM tblAdditionalInterests WHERE (InterestID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()) ORDER BY Interest
